items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: when the John Road show came to Thibodeau, George Backe was playing Clownet, you know.

ctx.x: Did you have anybody to help you much at all? Any lessons? No, no. No lesson.
Nobody. See? I just picked it up. In fact, sir, when the John Road show came to Thibodeau, George Backe was playing Clownet, you know. George who? Backe.
